notes: Material: 1020 steel. Title: ANGLE PLATE; model 180.
X follows the 5.75 length left-to-right in the broad view; Y follows its 4.00 width bottom-to-top; Z runs from the exterior upright face toward the projecting flange.
Datum A is the inner flange shoulder at X = D012 - D013. The inner upright face at Z = D011 has the printed .001 perpendicularity requirement to A.
All five .375 SHCS locations use the supplied standard chart; .375 is not the clearance drill diameter. Verify standard-derived dimensions against the MTI shop standard.
The D010 clearance-hole depths exceed both the upright thickness D011 and flange thickness D013, ensuring breakthrough without coincident cut endpoints.
Surface-texture callouts 125 and 250 and drawing tolerances are manufacturing requirements, not additional geometry.
